lint: @php -d error_reporting=24575 vendor/bin/phpmd bin,lib,public,tests text phpmd_unusedcode.xml --suffixes php,
lint:fix: @php -d error_reporting=24575 vendor/bin/phpmd bin,lib,public,tests text phpmd_unusedcode.xml --suffixes php,
scripts.complexity: @php -d error_reporting=24575 vendor/bin/phpmd lib html phpmd.xml --reportfile complexity.html --ignore-violations-on-exit

scripts-descriptions.tests: Prepare the database (db:prepare), then run all PHPUnit suites with HTML coverage in coverage/.
scripts-descriptions.tests:integration: Prepare the database (db:prepare), then run the PHPUnit integration suite (MySQL and Mailpit).
scripts-descriptions.coverage: Run PHPUnit and write Clover coverage to coverage/clover.xml.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Run phpcs, then the phpmd unused-code gate.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Auto-fix with phpcbf, then run the phpmd unused-code gate.
scripts-descriptions.docs: Generate API docs with phpDocumentor into phpdoc/.
scripts-descriptions.complexity: Write the informational phpmd complexity report to complexity.html.
scripts-descriptions.db:wait: Wait until the MySQL server accepts connections (DB_WAIT_TIMEOUT, default 60s).
scripts-descriptions.db:create: Create the DB_NAME database if it does not exist.
scripts-descriptions.db:drop: Drop the DB_NAME database if it exists.
scripts-descriptions.db:migrate: Apply pending migrations from migrations/ to DB_NAME.
scripts-descriptions.db:prepare: Wait for MySQL, create DB_NAME if missing, then apply pending migrations.
